newsitem.title: BELGIUM: Farm spending report shows 1.7 billion Ecus saving.
newsitem.headline: Farm spending report shows 1.7 billion Ecus saving.

text.p: Farm spending was 1.7 billion Ecus, or four percent, below the forecast 35.6 billion Ecus during the first seven months of 1996, a monthly report issued on Wednesday said.
The European Agriculture Guarantee and Guidance Fund (EAGGF) Guarantee report for September said that this was due to economy measures taken by the European Commission earlier this year.
The agricultural budget for 1996 was put at 41.7 billion Ecus. Spending, including other adjustments, is 81.2 percent of the estimated annual total.
The savings come primarily from delaying the second payment due to oilseeds growers - a total of 1.1 billion Ecus.
Another 600 million Ecus remains due to Italian oilseeds producers for their 1995 payments, the report added.
